name: Contribution type description code
description: Code specifying a type of contribution scheme.

values.name: Company award
values.description: Company award Company payment as per an industry or similar industrial award agreement.

values.name: Company over-award
values.description: Company over-award Company payment which is higher than an industry or similar award agreement.

values.name: Lump sum
values.description: Lump sum Payment is in the form of a single payment.

values.name: Company voluntary
values.description: Company voluntary A company payment which is paid on a voluntary basis.

values.name: Member voluntary
values.description: Member voluntary A member payment which is paid on a voluntary basis.

values.name: Member individual
values.description: Member individual Single payment by an individual member.

values.name: Group
values.description: Group Payment as part of a group plan or scheme.

values.name: Other
values.description: Other Contribution type differs from any of the other coded values.

values.name: Mutually defined
values.description: Mutually defined Mutually defined contribution type.
